columns.name: is_gap_vs_all_clients

comment: Product penetration vs peers (Opportunity Identification, mv_product_penetration): dense golden client x core product x fiscal year (FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 to date) for every client with an active product in the year - whether the client holds or used the product in the year, how widely the client's peer group (same industry subsector) holds it, and the gap. Penetration % = AVG(holds_product_flag) over the selected clients; Peer Penetration % = AVG(peer_penetration_pct); Penetration Gap pts = Peer - Penetration; Clients With Gap = clients with is_gap_vs_peers (not held while >= 50% of peers hold it). When the selection is a whole peer group (e.g. Japanese automotive-parts subsidiaries: every Auto Parts client is Japanese Corporate) the aggregate peer gap is 0 by construction - compare with sector_penetration_pct or all_clients_penetration_pct instead. One fiscal year at a time. Grain: one row per golden client x core product x fiscal year (dense).
